> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Pre-release: not signed by Mozilla yet.** Mozilla is reviewing this version for Firefox Add-ons. Until it signs it, the file here is the unsigned build, `zen-recorder-{version}-unsigned.xpi`. Once signed, the signed file replaces it here, and this version goes live on Firefox Add-ons.
>
> - **Firefox and Firefox Beta** refuse unsigned add-ons: wait for the signed file.
> - **Zen, Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly and ESR** can install it after you set `xpinstall.signatures.required` to `false` in `about:config`. That turns off the signature check for every add-on: once the signed file is here, install it over this one and set the pref back to `true`.
> - SHA-256 of the unsigned file: `{sha256}`
>
> The install steps below are for the signed release.
